capabilities: Import notes from other apps and file formats into a vault
Convert imported notes to plain Markdown files
Provide per-app import guides and templates
extras: Detailed import guides live in the separate obsidian-help repo rather than the README; README also documents developer workflow and test setup.
problem: Obsidian users moving from other note apps or file formats have no built-in way to bring their existing notes in as Markdown.
summary: Import plugin that converts notes from other apps such as Apple Notes, OneNote, Evernote, Notion, and Google Keep into plain Markdown files.
